run_rtn_fwrd: run RTN weight quantization on all linear layers of a transformer model and return quantizers
build_rtn_quantizers: build per-channel weight quantizers for each linear layer in a model using RTN quantization
test_rtn_fwrd: test the rtn_fwrd function by quantizing a model's linear layers with specified bit width and group size
review_rtn_fwrd: review the rtn_fwrd function to understand how it inserts weight quantizers into transformer model layers
refactor_rtn_fwrd: refactor the rtn_fwrd function to support additional quantization strategies beyond RTN
